title: 第13章 丰厚的奖励震惊的江家家主第14章 江家祖地老祖震惊
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 【叮！检测到宿主与道侣白清雪（评分98）成功构建连接，并使其成功受孕！】
【新手任务：完成！】
【评价：完美】
【正在结算奖励，触发暴击奖励，奖励增幅1000%！】
【恭喜宿主获得最终奖励：】
【一、修为：3境神魄境巅峰！】
【二、鸿蒙创世诀！】
【三、科技侧‘弑神一号’设计图一份！】
【四、升灵丹两枚！圣灵丹一枚！】
【五、体质增幅丹二十枚！】
【六：子嗣血脉强度晋级概率提升20%！】
轰！
庞大的奖励信息，如同潮水般涌入江渊的脑海，让他整个人都懵了。
【鸿蒙创世诀：仙法】
【圣灵丹：将体质直接提升至至高圣体】
这居然给的是仙法？！
我靠！
还是完整的！
江家确实有仙法，但那是江家数百万年一点点收集出来的残破仙法！
如今系统直接给了一门完整仙法？？
还有升灵丹跟圣灵丹？！
直接提升到圣体！
系统牛逼！
江渊激动得差点跳起来。
当然，对江渊自身来说，最重要的就是修为直接灌顶到神魄境！
这意味着哪怕他自己修炼无法增长修为！
只有能接受奖励，那他就可以不断变强，延长寿命！
【是否接受修为灌顶？】
“接受。”
下一刻，一股力量从江渊体内蔓延。
所谓天道不开的凡人根基在这一刻被荡平！
一境，二境，三境……
短短数息时间，3境神魄境巅峰，
成！
诚然，3境放在江家就连六七岁的小娃娃都比不过。
可对凡人18年的他来说已经是莫大的进步！
而就在这时，白清雪也因为江渊的动静而被吵醒。
她眸子还带着一丝初经人事的迷离和慵懒，不敢置信的看着眼前这一幕。
她看到了什么？
传言中凡体的江渊在几息间就能修炼，甚至还突破到神魄境？
“夫君……你，你这是……？”
她开口问道，声音带着一丝清晨的沙哑，别有一番风情。
content_en:
【bite! It was detected that the host successfully established a connection with Taoist companion Bai Qingxue (score 98) and successfully impregnated it! 】
[Novice mission: completed! 】
[Evaluation: Perfect]
[The rewards are being settled, the critical hit reward is triggered, and the reward is increased by 1000%! 】
[Congratulations to the host for receiving the final reward:]
[1. Cultivation: Peak of the 3rd realm of divine soul! 】
[2. Hongmeng Creation Technique! 】
[3. A copy of the design drawing of ‘Killing God No. 1’ on the technology side! 】
[Four, two spiritual elixirs! A Holy Spirit Pill! 】
[5. Twenty physical enhancement pills! 】
[Six: The probability of promotion of the offspring’s bloodline strength is increased by 20%! 】
Boom!
The huge amount of reward information flooded into Jiang Yuan's mind like a tide, making him completely confused.
[Hongmeng Creation Technique: Immortal Technique]
[Holy Spirit Pill: Directly upgrade your physique to the Supreme Holy Body]
This actually gives me magic? !
Holy shit!
Still complete!
The Jiang family does have immortal magic, but it is a broken magic that the Jiang family has collected bit by bit over millions of years!
Now the system directly gives a complete immortal method? ?
And the Ascension Pill and the Holy Spirit Pill? !
Directly ascend to the Holy Body!
The system is awesome!
Jiang Yuan was so excited that he almost jumped up.
Of course, for Jiang Yuan himself, the most important thing is for his cultivation to reach the divine realm directly!
This means that even if he practices on his own, he cannot increase his cultivation level!
As long as he can accept rewards, he can continue to become stronger and extend his life!
[Do you accept the cultivation initiation? 】
"Accept."
The next moment, a force spread from Jiang Yuan's body.
The so-called inexorable mortal foundation was wiped out at this moment!
One realm, two realms, three realms...
In just a few breaths of time, he reached the peak of the third realm of divine soul.
Done!
It is true that in the Jiang family, even a six or seven-year-old baby cannot compare to the third realm.
But for him, who has only been a mortal for 18 years, this is already a huge improvement!
At this moment, Bai Qingxue was also awakened by Jiang Yuan's movements.
Her eyes still had a hint of confusion and laziness as she looked at the scene in front of her in disbelief.
What did she see?
It is rumored that the mortal Jiang Yuan can cultivate in a few breaths, and even break through to the divine realm?
"Husband...you, what are you...?"
She asked, her voice carrying a hint of morning hoarseness and a unique charm.
title_en: Chapter 13: The rich reward shocked the head of the Jiang family Chapter 14: The ancestor of the Jiang family was shocked
